components_layout_rules.header: Sticky compacting nav bar with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#07182F]/90 border-b border-white/10 z-50. Gold active indicator on nav items. Mobile drawer with ESC key handler & body scroll lock
components_layout_rules.hero: Staggered framer-motion sequence: eyebrow -> headline -> paragraph -> dual CTAs (Explore Projects in Gold, Contact Concierge in Navy border). Background subtle ambient gradient overlay over architectural photo
components_layout_rules.trust_strip: Dark midnight navy #07182F background with 4 key metrics: '55+ YRS Combined Team Exp', '6 Core Leaders', 'Buyer-First Policy', 'Hyderabad Prime Hubs'. Precise gold dividers and bold numbers
components_layout_rules.project_grid: AnimatePresence with layout animations. Filter buttons styled with rounded-full pill shapes, gold highlight on active pill. Cards feature hover zoom, transparent 'Verification Pending' status badges, gold accent details
components_layout_rules.process_timeline: Interactive 5-step horizontal/vertical line with connecting gold trace indicator. Active step unveils detailed buyer guidance
components_layout_rules.team_grid: 6 cards with initial monograms (e.g. 'SV' in gold border box), neutral slate backgrounds, bio highlights, no fake stock photos
components_layout_rules.contact_form: Shadcn Form / input components with floating labels, submission handler with Sonner toast notification + direct WhatsApp link generator
components_layout_rules.footer: Dark midnight navy #07182F surface with rising skyline geometric logo motif, quick links grid, contact info, and legal disclaimer

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Use data-testid attributes on ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, links, cards, tabs, mobile menu trigger)

Strictly follow brand colors: #062858 primary navy, #07182F midnight navy, #F5AA00 signature gold, #C6A56A secondary gold, #EDF3FA soft ice blue, #F7F6F2 warm ivory. Gold ONLY for CTAs, highlights, badges, and active indicators
Never use dark colors as gradients. Do not use generic center-aligned layouts for full page text
Include content integrity: 55 years is cumulative experience of the 6 core members; use neutral monogram avatars for team; mark status as 'Verification Pending'
Use specific CSS transitions (e.g. transition-colors, transition-transform duration-300), DO NOT use 'transition: all'
Ensure mobile nav drawer traps focus, closes on escape, and prevents body scrolling
All form fields must be accessible with proper label associations and data-testid attributes
